# The `synthea:` types (reference)

<!-- Generated by `npm run api:gen` from extension/model/synthea.json and synthea.values.json. Do not edit. -->

The data model of the extension: **28 types** and **13 enumerations** in the namespace `https://forschungsgruppe-digital-health.github.io/schema/synthea/1.0` (prefix `synthea`; the version is in `package.json`). This page lists the data only. How to use the types is in the [modeling guide](modeling-guide.md) and in the [extension matrix](extension-matrix.md) (which type sits on which BPMN element); how to register the extension is in the [extension API](extension-api.md).

In the XML a type is written with a lower-case first letter: the type `DelayConfig` is the element `<synthea:delayConfig>`. An attribute is always optional in the model; which ones a state needs is checked by the lint rules and the converter, not by the schema. "Allowed values" are the literals of an enumeration, or the fixed lists that the XSD enforces for a text field.
